info.title: Pontx Hub Discovery API
info.description: Pontx Hub’s public, unauthenticated, read-only discovery API. It provides API product, Endpoint, Schema, SDK, and published Agent Skill lookup and download; account, AI, Playground execution, OAuth helper, and internal routes are outside this contract.

catalog/listCatalog.description: Returns curated API summaries compatible with v1 clients. Prefer the v2 product directory for metadataRevision and clearer resource boundaries.

skills/getHubSkill.description: Returns the Pontx Hub universal Agent Skill file map for v1 clients. New integrations should prefer the v1 Skills directory and individual bundle endpoint to verify version and content hashes.

200.description: The universal Skill v1 file map.

skills/listSkills.description: Lists the universal Skill and product Skills published from the same metadata revision, without file contents.

200.description: Installable Skill summaries and file hashes.

skills/getSkill.description: Returns UTF-8 files, per-file hashes, and the bundle content hash for one universal or published product Skill. Verify these hashes before installation.

200.description: Complete installable files for a verified Skill.

404.description: The requested Skill was not found.

legacy/getApiSpec.description: Returns the complete API summary compatible with v1 clients. Use getFullProductMetadata for layered, cacheable v2 metadata.

404.description: The requested API was not found.

legacy/getApiEndpoint.description: Returns one Endpoint detail and its API summary for v1 clients.

404.description: The requested Endpoint was not found.

legacy/getApiSdk.description: Returns an API’s npm package, version, optional product CLI, runtime, and specification hash.

404.description: SDK metadata for the requested API was not found.

legacy/getApiPricing.description: Returns reviewed API pricing metadata; it explicitly returns unknown when no material is available instead of inferring a price.

200.description: Reviewed pricing or an explicit unknown state.

404.description: The requested API was not found.

products/listProducts.description: Returns lightweight product identity, Endpoint/Schema counts, authentication types, and SDK status without request, response, or Schema details.

200.description: v2 product directory with the exact metadataRevision.

default.summary: Read the current v2 product directory

products/getProductSummary.summary: Get a product summary and resource directory
products/getProductSummary.description: Returns product metadata plus navigation-sized Endpoint and Schema summaries; it omits complete request, response, and Schema graphs.

200.description: Product summary with its resource directory.

404.description: The requested product was not found.

products/getEndpointMetadata.summary: Get complete metadata for one Endpoint
products/getEndpointMetadata.description: Returns the selected Endpoint, compact product directory, and localized PontxSpec Schema closure it requires.

200.description: Localized Endpoint and transitive Schema closure.

404.description: The requested Endpoint was not found.

products/getSchemaMetadata.summary: Get complete metadata for one Schema
products/getSchemaMetadata.description: Returns the selected Schema, compact product directory, and localized PontxSpec Schema closure it requires.

200.description: Localized Schema and transitive Schema closure.

404.description: See the canonical API documentation for this field.

products/getFullProductMetadata.description: Returns the complete product record and PontxSpec in the selected locale; it is intended for agents, offline indexing, and bulk tools rather than navigation-only pages.

200.description: Complete localized product metadata and PontxSpec.

404.description: The requested product was not found.

search/searchApiCatalog.description: Searches API products, Endpoints, inputs, outputs, and Schemas with a deterministic bilingual hybrid-semantic strategy, returning stable resource IDs and match provenance.

schema.description: A non-empty natural-language or identifier query.
Comma-separated api, endpoint, or schema resource types.

200.description: Ranked search results with strategy, version, and match provenance.

legacy/getApiSchema.description: Returns an API summary and one complete Schema for v2 clients. Use getSchemaMetadata when a transitive Schema closure is needed.

200.description: v2 API summary and complete Schema.

404.description: See the canonical API documentation for this field.

ErrorEnvelope.title: Error response
ErrorEnvelope.description: Machine-readable error object for the public Hub API. requestId correlates support requests and is not an authentication credential.

LocalizedText.title: Localized text
LocalizedText.description: Chinese and English text for the same field.

SdkSummary.title: SDK summary
SdkSummary.description: npm SDK and optional product CLI status for one API.

ProductSummary.title: API product summary
ProductSummary.description: API product identity and counts shared by directory and metadata resources.

id.description: Stable resource ID in api:<slug> form.

authTypes.description: Authentication types declared by this API.

EndpointSummary.title: Endpoint summary
EndpointSummary.description: Navigation-sized Endpoint identity and transport metadata.

id.description: Stable resource ID in endpoint:<api>/<endpoint> form.

tag.description: PontxSpec tag; ungrouped Endpoints can use an empty string.

SchemaSummary.title: Schema summary
SchemaSummary.description: Navigation-sized Schema identity and shape metadata.

id.description: Stable resource ID in schema:<api>/<name> form.

name.description: See the canonical API documentation for this field.

metadataRevision.description: Metadata Git revision that produced the response.

ProductSummaryEnvelope.title: Product resource directory response
ProductSummaryEnvelope.description: One product and its navigation-sized Endpoint and Schema summaries.

EndpointDetailEnvelope.title: Endpoint metadata response
EndpointDetailEnvelope.description: One localized Endpoint and its required PontxSpec Schema closure.

pontxSpec.description: PontxSpec fragment containing the Schema closure.

SchemaDetailEnvelope.title: Schema metadata response
SchemaDetailEnvelope.description: One localized Schema and its required PontxSpec Schema closure.

pontxSpec.description: PontxSpec fragment containing the Schema closure.

FullProductMetadataEnvelope.title: Complete product metadata response
FullProductMetadataEnvelope.description: Complete localized metadata and PontxSpec for one product.

SearchEnvelope.title: Search response
SearchEnvelope.description: Deterministic strategy, pagination, and match provenance for v2 global search.

SkillFileSummary.title: Skill file summary
SkillFileSummary.description: Safe relative path and SHA-256 for an installable file.

path.description: Safe relative path inside the Skill directory.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 file content.

SkillSummary.title: Skill summary
SkillSummary.description: Version and integrity summary for one installable universal or product Skill.

apiSlug.description: API slug for a product Skill; the universal Skill does not return this field.

contentHash.description: Bundle SHA-256 computed from sorted file paths and contents.

SkillListEnvelope.title: Skill directory response
SkillListEnvelope.description: Summary list of the universal Skill and published product Skills.

SkillBundle.title: Skill bundle
SkillBundle.description: Verified installable Skill with file contents.

SkillBundleEnvelope.title: Skill download response
SkillBundleEnvelope.description: v1 envelope for an installable Skill bundle.

LegacySkillEnvelope.title: Legacy universal Skill response
LegacySkillEnvelope.description: Universal Skill file map for legacy clients.

V1CatalogEnvelope.title: v1 API catalog response
V1CatalogEnvelope.description: API summary list for compatible clients.

V1ApiEnvelope.title: v1 API detail response
V1ApiEnvelope.description: Complete API detail for compatible clients.

V1EndpointEnvelope.title: v1 Endpoint detail response
V1EndpointEnvelope.description: API summary and complete Endpoint for compatible clients.

V1SdkEnvelope.title: v1 SDK detail response
V1SdkEnvelope.description: API SDK package and specification-binding metadata.

PricingEnvelope.title: Pricing metadata response
PricingEnvelope.description: Reviewed API pricing metadata or an explicit unknown state.

V2SchemaEnvelope.title: v2 Schema detail response
V2SchemaEnvelope.description: API summary and complete Schema for compatible clients.
